remarks: Location, location, location! Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome located on one of the most desirable streets in Greenwich. This home is conveniently located to Greenwich Avenue, the train station, Bruce Park, and the Bruce Museum. The main level includes a foyer with large closet, spacious living area with built-in bookshelves (ideal for home office use), a bedroom with full bath, and laundry room. The second level offers a living room with fireplace, dining area with sliding doors to the deck, and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and an under-sink reverse osmosis water filter. The third floor features two large bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, generous closet space, and two full bathrooms, including one en suite. Recent updates include new central air conditioning, furnace, boiler, and dishwasher (all within the last four years).
